note: The `required_packet_bytes` field is the source-grounded semantic view of the missing CASIC guard `inbuflen >= data_len + 10` that the staged patch inserts before the checksum and CRC fetch. The slot fields bind the same local scalar storage `&crc_computed` at the assignment and branch sites so the transition can prove the checksum result later consumed at the sink is the one produced by `casic_checksum()`.
